clue.text: Willing to bet

definitions.meaning: someone up for anything is ready and eager to have a go
an old verb sense meaning to gamble or play for stakes

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both an adjective for being up for something and an old verb for gambling.

clue.text: Losing fluid? Don't start drinking!

indicators.note: told not to start, the word loses its opening letter

parts.note: drinking heavily is boozing

explanation.surface: A warning to someone dehydrated not to begin a drinking session.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Don't start' removes the B from BOOZING.
explanation.definitionFit: Seeping liquid slowly out is losing fluid gradually, a near synonym.

clue.text: One in high church troubling yobs and young workers

indicators.note: the numeral one is placed inside the high-plus-church pair

parts.note: meat gone high has gone off
CE is the Church of England
the Roman numeral for one is I

indicators.note: yobs are troubled, so their letters are stirred up

explanation.surface: Young clerks are disturbed by louts while someone sits in a high church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'High' means OFF, as food that has gone bad; 'troubling' rearranges YOBS into BOYS.
explanation.definitionFit: Lads employed to run errands in an office are junior employees, young workers.

clue.text: Lied badly about theologian's do

indicators.note: the scrambled letters go around the theologian's letters
the word lied is done badly, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: DD is Doctor of Divinity, a theologian's degree

explanation.surface: Someone told a poor lie concerning a theologian's party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Badly' turns LIED into DILE, which goes 'about' DD. 'Do' is the verb, to cheat.
explanation.definitionFit: To do someone is slang for cheating or swindling them.

clue.text: Bale out, having seen off countryman

indicators.note: bale put out of order, its letters jumbled

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: seen sent off course, its letters rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A parachutist bails out after spotting something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Out' rearranges BALE into LEBA and 'off' rearranges SEEN into NESE.
explanation.definitionFit: A person from Lebanon is a fellow of that country, a countryman of it.

clue.text: Labour saving environment for stars

indicators.note: the words Labour saving surround the answer, holding it within them

explanation.surface: A labour-saving setting for celebrities.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters sit across the break between 'Labour' and 'saving'.
explanation.definitionFit: Ursa, the bear, names constellations such as the Great Bear, groups of stars.

clue.text: The girl who found love in a vehicle queue

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
love is zero in tennis, the letter O
a queue is a line

explanation.surface: A girl met her sweetheart while waiting in a traffic jam.
explanation.definitionFit: Caroline is a girl's first name.

clue.text: Mr Livingstone's home? Good negative feedback from part of London

parts.note: Ken Livingstone was a Mayor of London, so his is KEN'S
to be at home is to be in

indicators.note: the negative is fed back, read in reverse

parts.note: not is a negative

explanation.surface: Asking where a London politician lives, with a district answering favourably.
explanation.walkthrough: Ken Livingstone was London's mayor. 'Feedback' turns NOT into TON.
explanation.definitionFit: Kensington is a district in west London.

clue.text: Remote area making idiot flip

indicators.note: the idiot is flipped over, read backwards

parts.note: an idiot is a fool

explanation.surface: A distant place causes a fool to lose his temper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flip' reverses FOOL to give LOOF.
explanation.definitionFit: Being distant and detached in manner is a synonym for remote.

clue.text: Brew a beer in it and get drunk

indicators.note: to brew is to concoct, so these letters are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: Instructions for home brewing followed by drinking it.
explanation.walkthrough: The nine letters of A BEER IN IT are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb this word means to make or become intoxicated.

clue.text: Morally uplifted, made God swap leaders

indicators.note: the first two letters of the word trade places

parts.note: to be made a god is to be deified

explanation.surface: Someone raised in virtue, having turned God into a swap of leaders.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Swap leaders' exchanges the D and E at the front of DEIFIED.
explanation.definitionFit: Being instructed and improved morally or intellectually is being uplifted.

clue.text: Perplexed by volunteer army in a defeat

indicators.note: the army sits inside the phrase a defeat

parts.note: a defeat is a loss
TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve

explanation.surface: Someone baffled when a volunteer force is beaten.
explanation.walkthrough: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's part-time reserve force.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for not knowing what to do means puzzled or perplexed.

clue.text: A way of approaching fish

definitions.meaning: a point of view or slant taken on a subject
a verb meaning to go fishing with rod and line

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a viewpoint on a matter and to fish with a hook.

clue.text: Retort from disheartened wife in new snack bar

indicators.note: the remaining wife letters go inside the rebuilt snack bar
the snack bar is made new, its letters rearranged
wife loses its heart, leaving only its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A sharp reply coming from a sad wife in a refurbished café.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Disheartened' leaves WE from WIFE, which goes inside ANSRBACK, from 'new' rearranging SNACK BAR.
explanation.definitionFit: A cheeky reply is a retort, especially to someone in authority.

clue.text: Former European minister's first point arranged immunity

parts.note: ex means former

indicators.note: only the first letter of minister is taken
point is arranged afresh, its letters reordered

explanation.surface: An ex-minister's main point secured immunity from prosecution.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Arranged' rearranges POINT into PTION.
explanation.definitionFit: Being freed from an obligation or liability is immunity from it.

clue.text: Ham in cooking pot? Scour it!

indicators.note: cooking suggests the letters are stirred and changed

explanation.surface: Ham cooked in a pot leaves it needing a good scrub.
explanation.walkthrough: The ten letters of POT SCOUR IT are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Prosciutto is Italian cured ham.

clue.text: Unplanned boost to current

definitions.meaning: read cryptically, a spur (boost) belonging to the present moment

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means spontaneous, and literally reads as a stimulus of the present time.

clue.text: University doctor about to put everybody up for cover

parts.note: MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification
re means about or concerning

indicators.note: in a down clue, putting a word up reverses it

parts.note: everybody is all

explanation.surface: An academic doctor plans to put everyone up for shelter.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry, 'up' turns ALL into LLA.
explanation.definitionFit: An umbrella gives cover from rain, and is also a protective cover figuratively.

clue.text: Period when people righted a wrong

indicators.note: the letters are put wrong, jumbled into another order

explanation.surface: An era when people put right some wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of RIGHTED A are rearranged; 'when people' joins the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names the stage of life after retirement, a period of later years.

clue.text: Seem confused about basis for rebuilding such establishments

indicators.note: the confused letters wrap around the rebuilt ones
seem is confused, its letters jumbled
basis is rebuilt, its letters put together differently

explanation.surface: Rebuilding diplomatic missions seems muddled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Confused' makes EMES of SEEM, which goes 'about' BASSI, the letters of BASIS from 'rebuilding'. 'Such establishments' points back to the rebuilding.
explanation.definitionFit: Embassies are diplomatic establishments housing ambassadors.

clue.text: Main source of energy? The Spanish fish

parts.note: the main is the sea

indicators.note: the source of a word is its first letter

parts.note: el is Spanish for the

explanation.surface: Asking whether the ocean is where Spain gets power.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The main' is an old poetic name for the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: A sea eel, such as the conger, is a fish.

clue.text: Chicken for 4 — about a pint, initially

indicators.note: the swindle word goes about the a and initial letter

parts.note: a word for the answer to clue 4, a swindle, is con

indicators.note: only the initial letter of pint is used

explanation.surface: A recipe: a chicken for four people needs about a pint of stock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'For 4' points to the answer of 4-down, whose synonym CON goes 'about' A and P from 'initially'.
explanation.definitionFit: A capon is a castrated cockerel fattened for the table, a chicken.

clue.text: Sweet ballerina without a conditioner

indicators.note: the word is left without the a

parts.note: Pavlova is both a meringue dessert and the ballerina it was named after

explanation.surface: A ballerina who is sweet but has no conditioner.
explanation.walkthrough: PAVLOVA, a meringue dessert named after the ballerina Anna Pavlova, loses an A.
explanation.definitionFit: Ivan Pavlov conditioned dogs to salivate at a signal, a famous conditioner.

clue.text: Study in bed, covered in crumbs!

indicators.note: the study word sits inside bed

parts.note: taken as written
to read a subject is to study it

explanation.surface: Reading in bed leaves you covered in crumbs.
explanation.definitionFit: Food coated with breadcrumbs before cooking is breaded.

clue.text: Choice of food for a legislative assembly?

definitions.meaning: the selection of food one eats
a parliament in some countries, like Japan's

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both what one eats and an old name for a parliament.

clue.text: A question — and a very Italian strong drink

explanation.surface: Asking a question, and about a powerful Italian liquor.
explanation.definitionFit: Aquavit is a strong Scandinavian spirit flavoured with caraway.

clue.text: Pitch to get school principal demoted

indicators.note: the first letter is sent down to the bottom of the word in this down entry

parts.note: Eton is the famous English public school

explanation.surface: A head teacher is demoted, changing the school's sound.
explanation.walkthrough: ETON is the famous English boarding school; its first letter moves to the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Pitch and tone both describe the quality of a musical sound.

clue.text: Companion left three miles behind company

indicators.note: the left and miles pieces come after company

parts.note: a league is an old measure of about three miles

explanation.surface: A friend fell three miles behind the rest of the group.
explanation.definitionFit: A colleague is a fellow worker, a companion in work.

clue.text: Spine ruptured outside hospital!

indicators.note: the ruptured word goes outside the hospital letter

parts.note: something ruptured is torn

explanation.surface: A broken backbone means a trip to hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: A thorn is a sharp spine on a plant.
